fusions.name: Snapped Taut
fusions.desc: Pulls the thread you have trailed taut and deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning them for 0.8 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Unpicked Seam
fusions.desc: Your next weapon strike uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 16 slashing damage plus 60% more for each one, then leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Molted Coat
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, each affliction laid on you has a 50% chance to be shed back onto whoever inflicted it.

fusions.name: Only the Hem Torn
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
